class.name: Application
class.brief_description: Root of the game_framework Context hierarchy. Owns all service/manager instances.
class.description:
Application extends [Context] and owns the three core managers as member variables (not as Godot singletons): - [method get_activity_manager] — [ActivityManager] - [method get_resource_manager] — [ResourceManager] - [method get_service_registry] — [ServiceRegistry]
Create one in your main scene's [code]_ready()[/code]: [codeblock] var app = Application.new() app.initialize($UIRoot) app.register_activity("main", "res://scenes/main_activity.tscn") app.start_activity(Intent.new()) # ... set up ... [/codeblock]
Call [method shutdown] before quitting to gracefully drain all Activities, Dialogs, and Toasts.

method.name: get_activity_manager
method.description: Returns the [ActivityManager] owned by this Application.

method.name: get_resource_manager
method.description: Returns the [ResourceManager] owned by this Application.

method.name: get_service_registry
method.description: Returns the [ServiceRegistry] owned by this Application.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Creates the three managers, wires them together, and sets [param root] as the ActivityManager's root container. Must be called exactly once, before any Activity is started.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Drains all Activities, Dialogs, and Toasts, then destroys the three managers. Safe to call even if [method initialize] was never called.
